idea-plugin.name: Live SQLite for Android
idea-plugin.description:
Browse and edit the SQLite databases of a running Android debug app, live.

Your app needs the Android-Debug-Database (debug-db) library. The plugin shows nothing without it. Add JitPack to settings.gradle.kts:

dependencyResolutionManagement {
    repositories {
        maven { setUrl("https://jitpack.io") }
    }
}

and debug-db to the app module's build.gradle.kts:

debugImplementation("com.github.amitshekhariitbhu.Android-Debug-Database:debug-db:1.0.7")

debugImplementation keeps it out of your release build. Full guide: README.

The plugin talks to the debug-db server inside the app through adb forward.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0: first release. Browse tables with paging, sorting and a filter per column, follow foreign keys, edit cells and rows, and run your own SQL with completion, recent queries and favorites.
